assumptions: A complete hinge locus is identifiable; incomplete or fused/variant configurations require a separately documented variant protocol.
No arbitrary mm-wide band or tissue thickness is introduced.
Geometry is not extracted from the existing coarse CT mask.
record.boundary_rule: Follow the complete 3D leaflet-to-atrioventricular-junction hinge locus through the commissural attachments. Preserve its nonplanarity rather than replacing it with a flat circle.
excludes: leaflet free edges and coaptation line
homogeneous material ring of assumed thickness
a virtual projected or best-fit annular area
record.functional_rationale: Use the leaflet attachment locus as the reference supporting the valve apparatus, with closure and opening represented by distinct leaflet states.
record.model_role: leaflet-support reference; not itself a blood compartment or resistance parameter
record.normative_status: project operational definition; not new standard ontology equivalence
record.relation_to_anatomy: The current UBERON material anulus term remains unchanged. This local boundary is a landmark of attachment tissue, not owl:sameAs or owl:equivalentClass to that tissue. Material support and its boundary are represented separately.
required_geometry_fields: 3D hinge contour in image world mm
coordinate reference and original image provenance
record.source_vs_proposal: Literature motivates the anatomical distinctions; choosing this locus as the project boundary is our proposed modeling convention.
record.state_or_phase: Contour is indexed by cardiac phase t if measured in a living heart; no default systolic/diastolic coordinates are assigned. In fixed specimens record fixation state.

assumptions: The upstream/downstream control-volume partition is declared consistently and avoids overlap/gaps in a future mesh.
No patient-specific interface geometry, flow, effective area or pressure is inferred from the present CT.
If landmarks or the required surface construction are absent, this proposal remains symbolic and cannot yield a numerical area.
A nonplanar hinge contour has infinitely many spanning surfaces; the future construction method is part of the definition, not an anatomical fact.
record.boundary_rule: Choose an oriented spanning control surface whose boundary is the full nonplanar atrioventricular hinge contour. A surface-construction algorithm and version must be supplied before geometry is instantiated because a contour does not determine a unique spanning surface. Preserve the 3D contour; a planar projection is a different derived representation.
record.competence_assumption: Only a declared normally competent closed-valve approximation may set cross-interface flow to zero; a closed-phase label alone does not exclude regurgitation or leakage.
excludes: effective orifice area or vena-contracta cross-section
automatic equality to pressure-separating leaflet surface
record.functional_rationale: Define the port across which net volume is transferred between LA and LV; orient the normal in the reference antegrade direction LA → LV. Reverse/regurgitant transfer is allowed to have negative signed flux.
includes: state-dependent reference orientation and signed transport
record.model_role: transport port between declared control volumes; separate from anatomical ostium, actual open gap and functional area property
record.normative_status: project operational control boundary; not asserted exact mapping to FMA ostium
record.relation_to_anatomy: Keep the FMA anatomical opening and its current REVIEW boundary mapping. Link this functional interface with a local operationallyAssociatedWith annotation; do not add owl:sameAs, owl:equivalentClass or unverified standard relation IDs.
required_geometry_fields: interface mesh or planar region in image world mm
coordinate reference and original image provenance
phase/time and surface velocity if moving
record.source_vs_proposal: The control-cut choice, flux orientation and required geometry algorithm are project proposals; the sources support anatomical landmarks and the need to distinguish anatomical, geometric and functional definitions.
record.state_or_phase: Phase-specific hinge contour and spanning surface must refer to the same cardiac state. Diastolic opening and systolic closure must not be collapsed into a timeless open area.
record.transport_definition: For a moving interface use relative-to-surface velocity when defining net transport Q(t)=integral_S(t) (v-v_surface) dot n dA. This is a proposed measurement definition, not a computed flow result.
